results.question: How many customers placed completed orders in both 2024 and 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_both_years FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o2024 ON o2024.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o2024.status = 'completed' AND o2024.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' JOIN orders AS o2025 ON o2025.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o2025.status = 'completed' AND o2025.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the repeat purchase rate: the percentage of customers with at least 2 completed orders among customers with at least 1 completed order?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * repeat_customers / active_customers, 2) AS repeat_purchase_rate_pct FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_cnt >= 2 THEN c.customer_id END) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id) AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) AS t LIMIT 500

results.question: For each country, what is net revenue per customer, dividing by ALL customers in that country including those who never bought?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS net_rev_per_customer FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed' LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.country LIMIT 500

results.question: Which products have a margin below 40% based on list price and cost, where margin = (price - cost) / price?
results.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.cost, (p.price - p.cost) / p.price AS margin FROM products AS p WHERE (p.price - p.cost) / p.price < 0.40 LIMIT 500

results.question: Show the running total of net revenue by month for 2025.
results.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS month_net_rev, SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_net_rev FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average discount percentage by sales channel, weighted by item quantity, for completed orders?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS sales_channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.discount_pct) / SUM(oi.quantity) AS weighted_avg_discount_pct FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel LIMIT 500

results.question: For each customer segment, what percentage of its customers are active customers?
results.sql: SELECT c.segment AS segment, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.completed_orders > 0 THEN c.customer_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 2) AS active_customer_pct FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment LIMIT 500

results.question: How many completed orders have a net value above the average completed order value?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders_above_avg FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS order_net FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) AS per_order WHERE per_order.order_net > (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed') LIMIT 500

results.question: What percentage of completed orders include at least one discounted item?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * discounted_orders / NULLIF(total_completed, 0), 2) AS pct_orders_with_discount FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS discounted_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed') AS total_completed FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND oi.discount_pct > 0) AS sub LIMIT 500

results.question: Which month had the most customer signups?
results.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.signup_date, '%Y-%m') AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY signup_month ORDER BY signup_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many active customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

results.question: What was the revenue in H2 2024?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS revenue_h2_2024 FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the gross margin percentage overall (gross profit divided by net revenue)?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

results.question: Which sales channel performs best?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: What is our most popular product category?
results.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the net revenue by sales channel?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel LIMIT 500

results.question: Now only for orders placed in 2025.
results.sql: SELECT o.channel AS channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS net_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.channel LIMIT 500

results.question: How many customers are there in each country?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country LIMIT 500

results.question: And only those who signed up in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c WHERE YEAR(c.signup_date) = 2025 GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country LIMIT 500

results.question: Which 3 products were returned in the highest quantities?
results.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_returned_qty FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'returned' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_returned_qty DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: What about cancelled orders instead?
results.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_cancelled_qty FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_cancelled_qty DESC LIMIT 3
